_doc: Imitation pretraining + value regression on record shards (instructions only). Train/validation shards must come from build-dataset with build-splits partitions; final_eval shards are refused. Run: python tools/nfs.py pretrain --config configs/train/pretrain_default.json --model-config configs/model/fs_v1.json --train <train.npz> --validation <validation.npz> --run-dir artifacts/runs/pretrain-1 --i-authorize-training --time-limit-minutes 20
_note: draft_pick is ablated by default: the inherited draft_net_original is a separate validated model (CONTRACTS 5).
